Title: LSJ:Brother's Blood and Taste of Vitae Q

Messages.Author: GP41
Messages.Body:
Hi again,

Could vamp A taste the blood lost from opposing vamp B, even if vamp C
has healed the all damage in the current round of combat?

Taste stipulates that it has to be blood lost from opposing vampire due
to damage. Since Vamp C is not the opposing vampire in combat, I would
think that NO.

But the card text from Brother's Blood is kind of confusing here saying,
...burn his own blood to heal or prevent destruction from damage taken
by a member of...

Any help on that please.

GP41

> But the card text from Brother's Blood is kind of confusing here
> saying, ...burn his own blood to heal or prevent destruction from

you damage a vampire : if he looses blood , you can Taste it. If another
vampire, which is not in combat loses the blood for him, you can't taste it.
That's that simple =)

reyda
